# KaTeX 0.19.0

Official npm package: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.0.tgz

Vendored files: `dist/katex.min.js`, `dist/katex.min.css`, `dist/fonts/*` and `LICENSE`.
Files are served locally; production pages do not fetch KaTeX or fonts from a CDN.

Upstream documentation: https://katex.org/docs/api

The MIT license is retained in `LICENSE`. Application integration and tests are
in `static/core/js/math-rendering.js` and `scripts/verify_math_rendering.cjs`.
